assets.name: starshard
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone production game icon for Last Star, readable at 48-64 pixels in HUD and 38-70 pixels as a floating world pickup. The supplied image is a STYLE AND SUBJECT REFERENCE ONLY, an approved concept board. Extract the art direction, do not reproduce the board or make a sheet. Create one clean original isolated object. Rich celestial-gothic hand-painted fantasy material, crisp intentional planes, confident large silhouette, consistent soft upper-left key light, restrained luminous edge accents. Object centered and fills 80% of a square canvas, with 10% clear transparent padding on all sides; all glow and particles must terminate before the outermost 5%. True transparent alpha background, including spaces around and within the silhouette; no opaque rectangular background, no starscape backdrop, no checkerboard, no text, no letters, no frame, no UI, no ground plane, no cast-shadow slab. Keep only enough simple ornament to read when small.
Subject: Starshard. One long luminous sapphire-blue crystal spearhead angled lower-left to upper-right, white-hot four-point star within its center, simple slender antique gold/silver braces gripping crystal edges. Strong large blue and pale-white facets, tapered elegant spear silhouette. Two thin blue energy strokes closely following the diagonal crystal. Simplify small decorative stars away. No wide cloud or web of trails.
